dispositions.topic_text: How project_lock handles leading folders left partially created by a failed or crashed attempt
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a project lock found partly created (folders without the lock file) is completed by the next call; nothing created is removed.

dispositions.topic_text: How existing leading lock folders created by another project are reused, validated, or modified
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): an existing lock folder, created by any project's call, is used as it stands whatever its mode; only a folder the call creates takes STATE_FOLDER_MODE.
